q: How does a Kanpur saddlery unit work out a carbon figure per saddle?
title: Kanpur saddlery: carbon per saddle
short: Add the unit's energy emissions for the month, divide them across saddles by pieces or by leather area used, and add the bought leather and fittings per saddle from supplier or database factors. State which split you used so the buyer can follow it.
audience: Saddlery and equestrian goods makers in the Kanpur cluster exporting to Europe

p: Energy: kWh x 0.710 (FY 2024-25 grid factor) plus fuel litres or kg x IPCC defaults, for the month.
Share it across saddles finished that month.
Add materials per saddle: leather area, tree, fittings and packaging, each with its factor source.
Leather is a major material line, so the leather factor and the area per saddle matter. Measure area from your cutting records, not from a catalogue.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
